tests.fail_or_repair: Open a person/channel ledger and stop treating a call or contact row as rescue.
tests.label: Caller/person/channel binding
tests.question: Does the record bind the affected person, caller/bystander, channel, language, disability/access needs, callback, and location uncertainty before scoring emergency access?

tests.fail_or_repair: Join carrier, PSAP, transfer, backup, and outage records before treating answer as service.
tests.label: Routing and PSAP continuity
tests.question: Can the packet prove correct PSAP/center routing, transfer, queue, abandoned/overflow state, backup path, and outage fallback?

tests.fail_or_repair: Separate coordinate, routing, GIS, and responder use; repair map/location before closing rescue.
tests.label: Actionable location
tests.question: Was location accurate, timely, responder-visible, and actionable, including indoor, z-axis, dispatchable-location, GIS, and rural/tribal edges?

tests.fail_or_repair: Do not close on dispatch; demand unit contact or justified non-response evidence.
tests.label: Dispatch/CAD to unit handoff
tests.question: Does CAD/dispatch evidence connect priority, unit recommendation, assignment, radio/MDT delivery, mutual aid, status updates, and scene arrival/contact?

tests.fail_or_repair: Treat NEMSIS/national data as denominator only until local EMS clinical and handoff records are joined.
tests.label: EMS clinical and transport continuity
tests.question: Does EMS evidence prove assessment, treatment, medication, refusal, transport, destination, diversion, transfer-of-care, and clinical QA where relevant?

tests.fail_or_repair: Do not treat contact metrics as stabilization; join local crisis and transfer/follow-up records.
tests.label: 988 and behavioral-crisis continuity
tests.question: Does 988/crisis evidence prove routing, answer, backup flowout, language/deaf access, safety planning, mobile crisis, 911 transfer, and follow-up?

tests.fail_or_repair: Treat alert sent as unproven warning until receipt/comprehension/protective-action evidence is joined.
tests.label: Public alert and warning receipt
tests.question: Can the packet prove IPAWS/WEA/EAS authorization, message content, geography, timing, language/accessibility, receipt, and protective action?

tests.fail_or_repair: Open degraded-mode incident command and stop treating reliability certification as continuity.
tests.label: Degraded operations and resilience
tests.question: Does the packet document telecom, NG911, CAD, radio, cyber, power, vendor, backup-center, manual-log, reroute, and restoration states?

tests.fail_or_repair: Add access/function-needs lanes before claiming emergency service reached all affected people.
tests.label: Equity, language, disability, and setting access
tests.question: Were LEP, Deaf/HoH, disability, age, rural/tribal, homelessness, custody, school, nursing-home, hospital, and household-setting risks handled explicitly?

tests.fail_or_repair: Keep national metrics as denominator-only and require incident-level outcome and repair records.
tests.label: Outcome, remedy, and source-currentness
tests.question: Does the packet distinguish rules, self-reports, datasets, dashboards, monthly metrics, alerts, and incident records, then tie outcomes to QA/corrective action?

use_rule: Run emergency-response continuity tests whenever 911, text-to-911, RTT, VoIP/wireless routing, PSAP answer, NG911 profile, FCC reliability/location/outage evidence, CAD dispatch, radio/MDT delivery, EMS/NEMSIS data, 988 contact metrics, mobile crisis, IPAWS, WEA/EAS, outage, cyber, power, language/accessibility, or after-action records are cited as proof that help reached people. Separate caller/person, channel, routing, location, dispatch, responder, care, crisis, alert, degraded-mode, equity, remedy, and source-currentness before treating a call, dispatch, contact, alert, or dataset as rescue.
